title: iStat Menus Alternative for macOS | Better Resource Monitor
description: Compare iStat Menus and Better Resource Monitor for macOS. See the simpler, lighter menu bar monitor for CPU, memory, storage, GPU, and network usage.
heading: Better Resource Monitor vs iStat Menus for macOS
intro: iStat Menus and Better Resource Monitor are built for different jobs. iStat Menus is a bigger system utility with more sensors, controls, and extra detail. Better Resource Monitor is for the simpler use case: keep CPU, memory, storage, GPU, and network visible from the menu bar, notice unusual load quickly, and keep the monitor itself light enough to ignore. If you are looking for an iStat Menus alternative because you only need the everyday numbers, this page shows where Better Resource Monitor keeps things simpler.

sections.heading: Which one fits better
sections.body: If you want a full system suite with extra sensors and controls, iStat Menus covers more ground. If you mostly want a clean way to keep an eye on your Mac during the day, Better Resource Monitor is the more focused option. It sticks to CPU, memory, storage, GPU, and network usage instead of trying to become a control panel for everything.

sections.heading: Why Better Resource Monitor stays lighter
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor uses under 0.1% CPU on Apple Silicon and around 15 MB of memory. That lower overhead comes from keeping the feature set tighter and skipping the always-on sensor polling that heavier monitoring apps rely on. It is built to stay open all day without feeling like one more thing your Mac has to carry.

sections.heading: Easy to install, easy to trust
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor installs like a normal Mac app and is available on the Mac App Store with full features. No admin-password step, no root helper, no private APIs. Most people will not choose an app because of those details alone, but they do make the experience simpler and easier to trust.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor makes zero network requests. No analytics, no telemetry. Everything stays on your machine. Storage usage comes from OS-reported total/free capacity for the user's main storage volume, without reading file names, contents, external volumes, or per-volume details.

cta: If you want more sensors and controls, iStat Menus is still the bigger tool. If you want the smaller menu bar monitor, [Better Resource Monitor is free on the Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/better-resource-monitor/id6758237306) and the source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/alexx855/better-resource-monitor).
